issues.title: Probe runner conflated expected auth boundaries with functional PASSes
issues.description: The D7.0 probe runner assigned BLOCKED_BY_AUTH to any HTTP 401/403 response regardless of whether it was expected by the probe's intent. This allowed auth-gate confirmation probes to be miscounted as end-to-end functional verification.
issues.fix: D7.1 probe runner: expect_auth_block=True probes are classified BLOCKED_BY_AUTH (gate confirmed); expect_auth_block=False probes that receive 401/403 are classified FAIL.
issues.evidence: 23 probes re-run: 14 PASS (public/external endpoints), 9 BLOCKED_BY_AUTH (auth gate confirmations), 0 FAIL.

issues.title: FIVE_MINUTE_WALKTHROUGH.md claimed MRR 0.68 (2.6x BM25) — not supported by D5.1-v2
issues.description: The wrap-up section stated 'MRR 0.68, 2.6x BM25'. D5.1-v2 Experiment B shows BM25 MRR=0.75 and Snowflake neural MRR=0.75. The Archipelago concept resolver is evaluated in Experiment A (concept resolution accuracy), not passage MRR. No system achieves 0.68 MRR in D5.1-v2.
issues.fix: Replaced with accurate D5.1-v2 figures: Archipelago concept resolution 68.4% accuracy (26/38), BM25 passage MRR=0.75, neural dense MRR=0.75, Graph-Assisted MRR=0.4865 (heuristic).

issues.title: FIVE_MINUTE_WALKTHROUGH.md claimed 1.0 relationship-direction accuracy with USES/CONTRASTS_WITH
issues.description: Wrap-up listed 'Relationship-direction correctness distinguishing USES, REQUIRES, and CONTRASTS_WITH (1.0 accuracy)'. D5.1-v2 relationship audit: precision=0.0, recall=0.0, F1=0.0 over assessable relational queries. USES, CONTRASTS_WITH, and APPLIES_TO predicates are absent from the runtime graph schema.
issues.fix: Replaced with accurate disclosure: graph has RELATED/REQUIRES/UNLOCKS. 13/18 relational queries have predicates absent from the graph. No USES or CONTRASTS_WITH edges in deployed runtime.

issues.title: FIVE_MINUTE_WALKTHROUGH.md claimed 'independently reproducible'
issues.description: The document stated the system is 'live, deployed, and independently reproducible'. No independent reproduction has been conducted. Qrels are algorithmic (not human-verified); citation grounding audit was performed by the primary author only.
issues.fix: Removed 'independently reproducible' claim. Added honest disclosure of qrel provenance (ALGORITHMIC_RULE_BASED_CANDIDATE) and citation grounding status (29% strict precision, single annotator).
issues.evidence: research/d5_sigir_evaluation/d5_1_evaluation_results_v2.json > metadata > qrel_provenance; citation_grounding_audit.json > audit_metadata > independent_peer_review: false

issues.title: FIVE_MINUTE_WALKTHROUGH.md referenced stale d5_evaluation_results.json instead of d5_1_evaluation_results_v2.json
issues.description: Evaluation References table pointed to d5_evaluation_results.json (legacy, pre-D5.1 audit). Current authoritative source is d5_1_evaluation_results_v2.json.
issues.evidence: File: research/d5_sigir_evaluation/d5_1_evaluation_results_v2.json exists and is the D5.3-A source commit.

issues.title: DEMO_SCENARIOS.md checklist referenced USES edge in verification step
issues.description: Line 135: 'Confirm self_attention is connected via USES'. USES is absent from the runtime graph schema. The deployed engine uses RELATED, REQUIRES, UNLOCKS.
issues.fix: Updated to: 'Confirm self_attention is connected via RELATED or REQUIRES (not USES — absent from runtime schema)'.

issues.title: Citation grounding: 9/24 irrelevant or spurious citations across 5 audited queries
issues.description: The citation grounding audit (citation_grounding_audit.json) of 5 representative queries (Q01, Q08, Q21, Q23, Q39) found: 7/24 fully supported, 6/24 partially supported, 9/24 irrelevant or spurious, 1/24 unassessable. Strict precision: 29.2%. This is caused by over-broad concept-neighborhood retrieval returning topically adjacent but not claim-supporting passages.
issues.fix: No ranking-score tuning against held-out queries. Limitation disclosed in RELIABILITY_GATE_REPORT.md and in demo script notes. Deterministic citation filtering (require passage contains anchor concept name token) is a candidate fix for the development set.

issues.title: Authenticated chat, PDF reader, and workbook export workflows not independently browser-verified
issues.description: The D7.0/D7.1 probes confirm that guarded endpoints correctly reject anonymous callers, and that public endpoints (readiness, library snapshot, Koha, Crossref, DOI, arXiv) are live. However, the full authenticated flow (login -> chat -> citation -> reader) has not been verified with live browser session screenshots.
issues.fix: Requires authorized test-account credentials (Supabase email/password) for the hosted deployment. No credentials are available to this automated runner. Browser verification steps are documented in docs/sigir/FIVE_MINUTE_WALKTHROUGH.md. Verdict: BLOCKED — cannot claim browser-verified authenticated flow without credentials.
issues.evidence: WF1-03 to WF1-05: BLOCKED_BY_AUTH (expected). WF1-01 (readiness) PASS. No authenticated session token available in automated runner.
